# LumiVizStack

> LumiVizStack turns complex JSON into clear, interactive visualizations. Paste, connect an API, or upload a file.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lumivizstack.vercel.app/): Overview and quick start
- [Explore](https://lumivizstack.vercel.app/explore): Visualize your JSON data
- [About](https://lumivizstack.vercel.app/about): About the project
- [Guide](https://lumivizstack.vercel.app/guide): How to use LumiVizStack
- [API](https://lumivizstack.vercel.app/api-docs): API documentation
